newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Gujarat cotton show gains, Punjab steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian Gujarat cotton show gains, Punjab steady.

text.p: Indian Gujarat varieties on Friday extended gains while Punjab cotton moved in a narrow range to finish on a steady note, dealers said.
Gujarat varieties rose on the back of thin supplies and a shortage of ready stock.
"The slow progress of the monsoon in Gujarat region in the second round also aided the firm tendency," one broker said.

Among spot deals, Gujarat Kalyan rose by 100 rupees at 14,600/14,800 rupees per candy (355.56 kg), wagad cotton gained by 100 rupees at 13,200 rupees and Kala-ginned rose by 100 rupees at 12,500 rupees per candy.

Mill buying at the higher level however remained dull and volumes were low. Punjab cotton held steady in a narrow price band amid limited activity. Punjab saw-ginned was steady at 1,825/1,880 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), Bengal-deshi at 1,010/1,080 rupees and F-414 at 2,060/2,080 rupees per maund.
